product: GPM IMERG · satellite-estimated total precipitation (NASA POWER v10, annual mean)
processing: POWER annual mean regridded from 0.1° to 2° using area-weighted averaging; cells with less than 50 percent of their area covered are omitted. anomaly = value - cell mean over the baseline period.
citation: NASA POWER Project: NASA POWER Data v10. NASA Langley Research Center. https://power.larc.nasa.gov/ (CC BY 4.0). Derived from GPM IMERG (Integrated Multi-satellitE Retrievals for GPM), NASA Goddard. POWER marks this parameter as 'reviewing'.
